ensemble.narrative: Sampled 2,000 forward paths for BA over 5 trading days as a weighted mixture of 12 generator rules, seeded by 25 historical analogs that all closed on or before 2019-03-08 -- closest: BA 2011-08-08 (-16.5%), BA 2009-03-03 (-17.2%), BA 2008-11-11 (-18.0%). The coarse-grained result: median -1.0%, 90% interval [-14.0%, +10.2%]; the scenario prior (heuristic-fallback) contributed an expected -3.1% 5-day drift on the 45% of paths that accept drift, and a 1.28x width multiplier on all of them. Changing the generator rule moves the median by 4.2 percentage points, which is our honest uncertainty about the rule itself rather than about the noise draw.
